snippet.title: Sniper Dan | Release Date Announcement Trailer | Launches 17 September 2026
snippet.description:
🎯 Sniper Dan launches on 17 September 2026!

Clumsy County is full of problems... and you're just the person to help and solve them with a perfectly placed shot.

Take on hundreds of hilarious jobs, uncover hidden secrets and use your precision shooting skills to help the quirky residents of Clumsy County. 

From popping champagne corks and trimming peg legs, to rescuing hats and fixing disasters, every job presents a new challenge in this family-friendly hidden-object adventure with a unique twist.

Features:
🎯 Over 100 unique jobs to complete
🔍 A fresh twist on hidden object gameplay
😂 Wholesome humour and satisfying problem-solving
🏡 Explore the colourful world of Clumsy County
🏆 Unlock upgrades, collectibles and secrets

Coming 17 September 2026
🖥️ Steam - Play the Demo (https://store.steampowered.com/app/3360680/Sniper_Dan_Demo/)
🎮 PlayStation 5
🎮 Xbox Series X|S
🎮 Nintendo Switch

Wishlist Sniper Dan today and prepare to become Clumsy County's greatest problem solver!
